dimensions.note: 산업연구원's '2026년 경제·산업 전망' page independently reproduces the sentence-final bare-noun compression already found at KDI (ref:kdi-economic-outlook-report, discovery): a long clause-chained sentence ('소비와 수출이 ... 회복세를 보이고, ... 확대되면서 성장을 견인') ends on the noun '견인' with no closing predicate. This corroborates the trait at a second, independent institution (an industrial-policy research institute, not a central bank), from a different subject-matter angle (manufacturing/industry vs. macro forecast). This record validates the trait; it does not originate it — the trait was already derived from KDI before this reference was read.
dimensions.evidence: "국내 실물경기는 소비와 수출이 2025년 2분기에 회복세를 보이고, 3분기 들어 정부의 소비 지원책과 글로벌 IT경기 개선 등에 힘올어 증가세가 확대되면서 성장을 견인" — ends on bare noun '견인', no copula, chained via 고/들어/에 힘입어/면서.

dimensions.note: A second sentence on manufacturing employment does close on a full predicate with an evidential hedge ('...모습을 보이고 있다'), showing the bare-noun ending is not universal within this same document — it is used selectively on forecast/trend-summary clauses, not on every sentence. Recording this rather than overclaiming uniform sentence-final compression.
dimensions.evidence: "코로나19 이후 제조업 고용은 비교적 큰 충격 없이 빠르게 회복하는 모습을 보이고 있다" — full predicate, hedge via '비교적' and '모습을 보이고 있다', not a bare-noun ending.

strengths: Independent-institution corroboration of the sentence-final bare-noun compression trait first observed at KDI: a different institution (industrial/manufacturing-policy research vs. macro/monetary), same device (a long clause-chained sentence ending on a bare noun like '견인' rather than a finite predicate) on a forecast/trend-summary clause specifically.

The same document shows the device is selective, not blanket: an employment-recovery sentence in the same piece closes on a full predicate with an evidential hedge ('모습을 보이고 있다') rather than a bare noun — useful boundary condition on when the compression device is reached for.
weaknesses: This record was assigned holdout before reading and validates a trait already derived from ref:kdi-economic-outlook-report; it must never be treated as having originated the bare-noun-ending finding.
Only the outlook landing/summary page was read, not a full downloadable report body if one exists separately; paragraph-level rhythm and full-document density are unverified.
